text:
Noah Reed: Pushed a slim mock for the latency card with a tiny timeline scrubber + sampling presets. Looking for clarity on preset names + how we surface that "sampled" state. https://figma.com/file/new-latency
Aisha Khan: Love the scrubber idea for quick drilldowns. Quick naming thought: avoid jargon  'Preview (10%)', 'Balanced (50%)', 'Full (100%)'  clear to non-ENG.
Ben Foster: Agree on names. Also we should put a small p95 badge with a micro-sparkline in the legend so PMs can scan trend and absolute. Keep the badge visually lighter than the metric card.
Yuki Tan: Accessibility nit: the preset menu must announce the currently selected preset via aria-live or aria-checked. Screen readers should hear "Preview selected, 10% sampling" when changed.
Noah Reed: Good call. Proposed aria for listitems:
```
role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Preview, 10 percent sampling"
```
Aisha Khan: Heatmap color stops: let's adopt Viridis perceptually-uniform palette (good for colorblind) and increase mid-tone contrast.
Ben Foster: Also animate heatmap transitions subtly when range changes. But ensure prefers-reduced-motion respects user setting.
Yuki Tan: For the 'sampled' overlay, we should show a top-left pill: "Sampled view  10%" with aria-describedby linking to a hidden paragraph that explains bias and how to get full fidelity. Keyboard focusable.
Noah Reed: Banner copy options for long ranges: 1) "Large range selected  results are sampled to keep preview responsive." 2) "Showing sampled data to speed up preview (10%)." Prefer concise 2.
Aisha Khan: Add action buttons: "Change sampling" and "Explain sampling". Make the primary action the one that opens the presets.
Ben Foster: UX edge: when the user nudges the time range small -> we should auto-restore to previous sampling if it was lowered, but only if user didn't explicitly pin a preset. Show a subtle toast: "Sampling restored to 100%".
Yuki Tan: Keyboard shortcut request: `.` toggles sampling menu. Make sure shortcut docs include a11y caveat.
Noah Reed: p95 tooltip content proposal: line1: "p95 (window: 1m)" line2: "420 ms" line3: small link "how p95 is computed". Keep tooltip under 200ms render.
Aisha Khan: Microcopy tweak: change "Sampled view" alt copy to "Partial view (sampled)"  reads less like a bug.
ops-bot: CI lint: color contrast for preset label "Balanced (50%)" fails minimal for 12px. Recommend +bold or +#0F172A.
img-bot: Uploaded: designs/latency/scrubber-sampler-presets-v1.png
Noah Reed: Thanks all  I'll update figma (include prefers-reduced-motion and aria snippets) and share a follow-up for final a11y pass.
